description: The Expectation paper's final run of gemma4:31b (13 Nov 2026): vendor sampling (temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 64), reasoning low (as the gateway then served it: thinking without a limit), max_tokens 32768, traffic and top-up in stage 1, known data only, the study's purpose map. Was expectation-paper/study-2026-11/skuld_config_vllm_gemma_vendor.json. Self-contained since 20 Nov 2026, when config.json took gemma's recommended sampling and thinking xhigh: it states every value the run had from config.json then. Since 20 Nov 2026 03:26 the gateway caps gemma4's thinking by level (low: 1,024 tokens; xhigh: no limit; docs/INFERENCE_GUIDE.md); before then every level was thinking without a limit. The profile keeps "low": a sample's options (think among them) identify it, so the run's samples are kept only under "low". A question asked anew under it today gets thinking capped at 1,024 tokens, unlike the run. The purpose vocabulary is dpv-purposes 2.3, whose nodes the stage-1 prompts list (2.3.1, since Ratatoskr 0.32.0, adds one). Its prompts are those it was asked with (versions before 20 Nov 2026, when the context moved to the end; skuld/templates.py); the proposer's are not kept, since its generator 2 also leaves notices out.
